original_source_action_law: Source-blind random.Random(1000003*seed+337), 96 original actions max; identical legal event source role for all learned arms

Same trained procedure using current and previous two lawful complete public observations/actions, no future knowledge
Previous exact-hash count prior retained as historical reference, not competitive baseline
target: Exact actual next original PUBLIC frame at every byte position, score independent-factor normalized categorical joint log probability; each byte's 256-valued alphabet normalized using training-seen symbols plus uniformly distributed unseen remainder. Unlike historical previous eight-change indicators, different original next public states retain distinct target identities.

architecture.selection_rule: minimum mean TRAIN-ONLY selection-source-episode full-frame negative log likelihood; ties lower learning rate then lower initialization seed; freeze before prospective original DEV

evaluation: Mean per-episode original full-public-next-frame categorical joint negative log likelihood in nats; paired 12 independent reset clusters; 1000 fixed-seed independent-cluster bootstrap with percentile interval. Do not use individual transitions as independent replicates.
decision: Positive bounded developer history signal only if the history-aware neural control beats the selected fitted full-current neural control on both independent sources with strictly positive per-reset-cluster 95% bootstrap lower bounds, and only if train-only selection loss is finite. NO native cognition, no scientific first use, no proof of Bayes/symbolic/RNN competence or full ITD-01.
